findings.status: conditional presentation integrity risk; no confirmed defect
findings.evidence: PrintJobQueryService.cs:183-203 uses saved expected/actual/difference when available but recomputes breakdown; PrintRules.cs:555-577 prints breakdown components and expected total. Post-close mutability policy not examined.
findings.next: Check close writer and post-close mutation constraints before promoting.

findings.status: probable shift-scope presentation defect; no accounting balance impact established
findings.evidence: LoadCloseWarningsAsync (PrintJobQueryService.cs:216-219) counts all Status==Open DriverCustodies without shift join. Counterevidence: DeliveryRules.UnsettledCustodyForShift (src/Falah.Domain/Delivery/DeliveryRules.cs:99-104) restricts custody by deliveries whose ShiftId matches the requested shift; DeliveryRulesTests.cs:120-130 explicitly excludes another shift. CloseShiftHandler.cs:81-84 says outstanding custody is shown on this shift handover slip; DeliveryRules.cs:94-97 likewise describes shift handover slip and marks it not a shift-close blocker. DeliveryVerticalSliceTests.cs:825-860 verifies one same-shift custody appears, but not cross-shift leakage.
findings.implication: The slip’s open-custody warning count/value can include a different shift’s delivery, contrary to the named shift-scoped helper and comments. This is a presentation/reconciliation-scope issue, not evidence of a ledger posting or expected-cash error.
findings.counterevidence: Could have an intentionally global handover policy; no owner policy found in evidence reviewed. Existing test only establishes same-shift inclusion.
findings.next: Coordinator mirror and owner should confirm wording/policy; if intended shift-scoped as source comments imply, change query to use delivery ShiftId semantics and add cross-shift test (outside this audit task). No source change made.
